trees.name: Village
trees.description: Restore Hollowmere. Buildings cost gold and materials, produce more materials after every delve and open the other trees.

trees.name: Equipment
trees.description: The Forge makes your golems tougher, stronger, faster and able to see further. Most of it is made of iron from the Smelter.

trees.name: Arcana
trees.description: The Arcane Tower teaches spells. Each spell is a new function your code can call.

nodes.name: Rebuild the Forge
nodes.description: Fire up the old forge. Opens the Equipment tree.

nodes.name: Arcane Tower
nodes.description: Rebuild the mage's tower. Opens the Arcana tree.

nodes.name: Great Forge
nodes.description: A bigger anvil and hotter coals unlock heavy equipment.

nodes.name: Observatory
nodes.description: A telescope on the tower roof unlocks advanced Arcana.

nodes.name: Water Mill
nodes.description: Grinds the valley's grain for the traders: +3 gold after every delve.

nodes.name: Market Stall
nodes.description: Traders pay more for dungeon loot: +10% gold from delves.

nodes.name: Cottages
nodes.description: Townsfolk move back in: +4 gold after every delve.

nodes.name: Market Square
nodes.description: Merchants from the valley: another +15% gold from delves.

nodes.name: Woodcutter's Hut
nodes.description: A woodcutter settles by the forest: +4 wood after every delve.

nodes.name: Guild Hall
nodes.description: Room for a second golem: the Seeker joins your party with its own program.

nodes.name: Guild Hall, second floor
nodes.description: Room for a third golem: the Striker joins your party.

nodes.name: Mine Carts
nodes.description: Carts haul stone up from the shallow tunnels: +6 gold and +3 stone after every delve.

nodes.name: Stone Quarry
nodes.description: Cut stone from the hillside: +3 stone after every delve.

nodes.name: Smelter
nodes.description: A furnace that turns iron ore into iron. You write its script: when to stoke the fire and when to smelt.

nodes.name: Wheat Fields
nodes.description: Plough the old fields: +3 wheat after every delve, and a farming drone you program to grow much more (wheat and pumpkins).

nodes.name: Bakery
nodes.description: An oven for bread. You write the baker's script: knead, light the fire, bake, and take it out in time.

nodes.name: Harvest Tavern
nodes.description: Pumpkin pie and warm bread bring travellers: +5 gold after every delve and +5% gold from delves.

nodes.name: Greenhouse
nodes.description: Glass from mine crystal keeps the fields warm: +4 wheat and +2 pumpkins after every delve.

nodes.name: Lantern
nodes.description: Golems see 1 tile further.

nodes.name: Iron Plating
nodes.description: +6 max HP for every golem.

nodes.name: Stone Fists
nodes.description: +1 attack damage.

nodes.name: Rune Core II
nodes.description: +20 instructions per tick: more thinking before each action.

nodes.name: Spare Recall Stone
nodes.description: Each golem can recall() one more time per delve.

nodes.name: Warhammer
nodes.description: +2 attack damage.

nodes.name: Bright Lantern
nodes.description: Golems see 2 more tiles.

nodes.name: Steel Plating
nodes.description: +1 armor and +6 max HP.

nodes.name: Oiled Joints
nodes.description: Every step takes 1 tick less.

nodes.name: Rune Core III
nodes.description: +40 instructions per tick.

nodes.name: Crystal Lens
nodes.description: A lens cut from mine crystal: golems see 1 tile further.

nodes.name: Essence Core
nodes.description: Monster essence burns bright in a rune core: +30 instructions per tick and +4 max HP.

nodes.name: Mana Well
nodes.description: Golems carry 8 mana, which refills slowly during a delve. Check it with mana().

nodes.name: Spell: reveal()
nodes.description: reveal() shows every trap and the layout within 6 tiles. 2 mana.

nodes.name: Spell: heal()
nodes.description: heal() restores 8 HP. 4 mana.

nodes.name: Spell: bolt(enemy)
nodes.description: bolt(enemy) strikes any enemy in sight for 5 arcane damage. 3 mana.

nodes.name: Spell: shield()
nodes.description: shield() halves damage taken for 5 seconds. 3 mana.

nodes.name: Deep Well
nodes.description: +12 mana.

nodes.name: Ley Line
nodes.description: +16 mana.
